description.en:
Adds a floor attribute to a zone registered with CMND_BTL_REGIST_FLOOR_ATTR.

An attribute is a bit number: the zone keeps a 32-bit mask and this call sets bit (1 << attr) in it. A zone can carry several attributes at once, and where zones overlap their masks are combined.
The match reads these bits to decide how the ground behaves. The hazard maps use attributes 1 to 4 for the quicksand depth and 5 for the lowered-pitch sections.
Nothing happens if no zone has that name.
Name of the zone, as registered with CMND_BTL_REGIST_FLOOR_ATTR.
Bit number of the attribute to add (0 to 31).

true once the call has run, whether or not the zone was found.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.
